scope: All three current proposed finished images, including retained composition; visual review only. Reviewer generated none of these images.

images.inspection: Entire finished image opened with view_image detail=original, native dimensions; no resized-image notice for this finished artwork.
findings: Neet has a continuous full narrow torso, fine legs, broad triangular ears, projecting muzzle and small rump nub. The visible paws are grounded; the far hind foot is occluded by the stool rather than severed. Buddy has connected shoulders, neck and elongated body, three supporting paws and one clearly lifted forepaw, with real underbody clearance.

Both torso coats have smooth, restrained painted fields, without engraved curls or enlarged shag contours. Buddy retains regional muzzle, brow and ear furnishings and pale distal legs; the dark tapering tail is separate from the legs.

Raised paw and downcast gaze, soil tracks, torn tomato packet and seeds in chai communicate the two dogs’ mistakes. Squirrel is back on the parapet. Cup sits on the stool behind Neet, consistent with this exact narrative state. The bed is bare disturbed soil; background established potted vegetation does not depict newly germinated seed rows.
Terrace perspective, raised bed edges, stool support and shadows are coherent. Props do not fuse into dog anatomy. No material visual defect found.

images.inspection: Entire finished image opened with view_image detail=original, native dimensions; no resized-image notice for this finished artwork.
findings: Neet stands on four distinct grounded paws with a continuous neck, chest and full narrow trunk. His ears, cream throat, muzzle projection and tiny nub preserve identity. Buddy’s elongated body, substantial legs and clearance remain connected; the gnome partially occludes one foreleg without creating an extra limb.
Smooth tan and charcoal body washes avoid the previous finish failure. Buddy’s furnished brow, muzzle and hanging ears remain regional, with short torso contour and a slender dark tail.

Neet’s fixed suspicious stare opposes the smiling undamaged gnome; Buddy looks toward the empty pots and visibly withdraws from the dispute. This is the pause before the attack, not a prematurely chipped gnome or duplicated action scene.

Ceramic base and all visible paws contact the terrace. Empty pots match the joke; established background flower pots are compatible with garden restoration. Warm coherent daylight and clean edges provide finished readability. No material visual defect found.

images.inspection: Entire finished image opened with view_image detail=original, native dimensions; no resized-image notice for this finished artwork.
findings: Neet has four separately traceable planted paws, fine substantial-enough leg shafts, full torso and thigh, continuous neck, broad ears and tiny nub. Stance, floor shadows and reflections support his weight without disconnected joints or floating feet.
Tan coat is smooth with restrained painted shading; no curly or shaggy body texture. Cream throat/chest and projecting dark-rimmed muzzle preserve likeness.

Proud raised head faces the closed nozzle and discrete last drops, matching the temporary victory before Heather restarts the spray. Hand grip has coherent thumb/fingers and hose connection. Heather’s appearance remains provisional; only her hand/forearm is depicted.

The trellis is bare, seed bed contains soil without prematurely grown beans or spinach, and the potted lime is a sapling. Water droplets, ripple and wet paving make the stopped spray legible. No material visual defect found.
